shadowSentences: I like to read books every day.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Traveling to new places makes me feel alive.
I enjoy cooking new recipes during weekends.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
Spending time with friends brings me joy and laughter.
I usually go for a walk in the evening after dinner.
Taking photographs allows me to capture beautiful moments.
Learning a new language can be challenging but rewarding.
Volunteering at the local shelter has been a fulfilling experience for me.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you tell me about a memorable trip you’ve taken?
Q2: What challenges did you face while planning that trip?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of travel in personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What sports or activities do you enjoy doing?
Q2: Have you ever faced any obstacles in maintaining a regular exercise routine?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is physical fitness in daily life?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone trying to get started with exercise?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: Can you describe a time when you participated in an eco-friendly activity?
Q2: What challenges do you think people face in adopting green habits?
Q3: How do you view the role of individuals in combating climate change?
Q4: What actions can people take to reduce their environmental impact?
